# Calendar message fixtures

These synthetic messages use example addresses. Google Calendar shapes use an
IANA VTIMEZONE, RRULE, EXDATE and occurrence messages with RECURRENCE-ID.
Microsoft Outlook and Exchange shapes use a Windows TZID and
X-MICROSOFT-CDO properties. Apple Calendar shapes use an IANA VTIMEZONE
and DURATION, or a DATE start with no end. The zone database supplies the
offsets. The VTIMEZONE body does not supply offsets to the calendar store.
